normalization_rule: Canonical registries remain authoritative; DB runtime is an operational projection. Current analysis projections are compared against source registries, preserving status and claim ceilings.

findings.title: D-semantics remains source-open despite empty runtime debt

findings.title: Validation is warning-level rather than clean-pass
findings.statement: The health report has overall_status=warning, clean_pass_eligible=false, and degraded stages hygiene_validation, math_program_validation, and report_write, with no failed stages.
